newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - UAL FY97 estimate trimmed.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - UAL FY97 estimate trimmed.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co said Thursday it trimmed its "enthusiastic" forecast for UAL Corp.'s fiscal 1997 earnings to $8.50 from $9 to reflect less leverage and the cost of improved services.

-- Analyst Steve Lewins said Gruntal continues to rate UAL outperform in light of an upbeat meeting the company held with airline analysts Wednesday that predicted improved profitability, three-percent capacity growth to sustain a high load factor and improved on-board services.
-- UAL is the parent of United Airlines.
-- The company's stock was down 1/8 at 59-3/4.
